prompt.description: Agent-visible task instruction. Do not include GT, A1-E3 labels, intended error mechanisms, or standard answers.

input_paths.description: Agent-visible input data paths. These must point to task inputs, not reference answers.

expected_outputs.description: Agent-visible output artifact names or requirements, not reference output paths.

metadata.description: Agent-visible safe metadata such as dataset id, task level, asset types, and output requirements.

scoring.description: Offline-only scoring configuration. This must never be included in task.agent_view() or agent prompts.
